name: Jesuit Block and Estancias of Córdoba
description: In the heart of Córdoba, Argentina, the Jesuit Block gathers a university, a church, a residence and a college around a single city block. Five rural estancias, or farming estates, lie in the hills beyond, each with its own chapel and working buildings. Together they show how the Jesuits ran a religious, social and economic experiment for over 150 years, until the 18th century.
